summary: Avista Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the issuance and sale of $90 million of 4.77% first mortgage bonds due 2029 and $70 million of 6.10% first mortgage bonds due 2056 to institutional investors in a private placement, with an additional $70 million of 6.10% bonds expected in August 2026. The bonds were issued under an existing Mortgage and Deed of Trust with Citibank as trustee, secured by substantially all company property. Proceeds will refinance debt and fund utility capital expenditures. The filing also notes results of the 2026 Annual Meeting. This is a routine debt financing and meeting disclosure, not a special situation.
